title: Linux Server Administration
tagline: An Ubuntu server set up and hardened by hand: partitions, users, firewall, SSH, FTP, MySQL, WordPress and backups.
summary: A system administration project on Ubuntu Server. I installed the server with a custom partition layout, managed users and permissions, configured a firewall, hardened SSH, and set up FTP, MySQL and a WordPress site, with backups scheduled by cron.
problem: Run a small production-like server and keep it safe: only the right people get access, only the needed ports are open, and data is backed up without anyone thinking about it.
features: Custom disk partitioning at install time
A MySQL database and a WordPress site
